_notes: Source of truth for the ElevenLabs voice agent. Apply with scripts/apply_agent.py --stage greet (step 1.1) or --stage full (step 2.3). See .claude/skills/voice-agent/SKILL.md.
The prompt lives in config/elevenlabs_prompt.md; apply_agent.py reads prompt_file into prompt.prompt.

Shapes follow the ElevenLabs API as read on 2026-10-03: agent = POST /v1/convai/agents/create or PATCH /v1/convai/agents/{agent_id}; each entry in tools = POST /v1/convai/tools, and the returned ids go in conversation_config.agent.prompt.tool_ids.
{{BASE_URL}} is replaced with PUBLIC_BASE_URL at apply time. tools_secret is an ElevenLabs workspace secret holding TOOLS_SHARED_SECRET. Never put real secrets in this file.

D17 fields, checked against https://api.elevenlabs.io/openapi.json on 2026-10-03: webhook response_timeout_secs is 5-300 (inline tools use 15); pre_tool_speech auto|force|off ('force' makes the agent say a filler before inline tools); ObjectJsonSchemaProperty supports nested properties + required (preapproval); built_in_tools.skip_turn params {system_tool_type: skip_turn, wait_timeout_secs} (the silence timer pauses during the wait, then the agent checks in).

Silence (D17): turn.turn_timeout max is 30 s (docs, conversation-flow), so 60 s can't be one setting. 30 s of silence -> the agent calls skip_turn; after its 30 s wait it checks in with 'Anything else?' (~60 s); the next silent turn (~90 s) says goodbye and calls end_call. silence_end_call_timeout 90 is the backstop. TODO(verify) on a live call: the timer pause and that the check-in follows the prompt.

Voicemail (D17 follow-up, 19:35): built_in_tools.voicemail_detection {system_tool_type, voicemail_message} per the OpenAPI VoicemailDetectionToolConfig; the message supports dynamic variables. Added after the 19:30 arrival call talked to Daniel's voicemail greeting for 112 s.

callback_agent (21:35): a second agent for arrival and exception calls (app/calls.py places them with ELEVENLABS_CALLBACK_AGENT_ID). Same prompt, tools and built-ins, but turn_timeout 10 so 'If you don't have anything else, I'm going to hang up' is followed by a hang-up after ~10 s of silence. ElevenLabs can't override turn_timeout per call (TurnConfigOverride only allows soft_timeout_config), so a second agent is the only way to keep the departure call's 60/90 s silence rule. silence_end_call_timeout 30 is the backstop.

end_call.name: end_call
end_call.description: Hang up. Only when the driver says goodbye or that's all, when the caller is not allowed, or after 'Anything else?' got no answer.

skip_turn.name: skip_turn
skip_turn.description: Stay silent for now: the driver has gone quiet or asked for a moment. You'll get a turn to check in after the wait.

voicemail_detection.name: voicemail_detection
voicemail_detection.description: Call this as soon as you hear a voicemail greeting or an automated message instead of the driver. It leaves the update and hangs up.

params.voicemail_message: Shotgun here with your update. {{summary}} Call me back on this number if you want to say yes or no to anything.

tool_config.name: search_web
tool_config.description: Search the web now and answer: places near the driver, opening hours, scores, weather, prices, news, quick facts. Knows the driver's location and destination. Takes a few seconds; say a short filler first. Returns one or two sentences to read back.

query.description: The question, in the driver's words.

tool_config.name: draft_message
tool_config.description: Draft a short message now, to read back word for word before anything is sent. Sends nothing. Say a short filler first.

intent.description: What they want to say, in their words.

tool_config.name: set_destination
tool_config.description: Set where the driver is headed and get the drive time (Google traffic). Takes a few seconds; say a short filler first. Returns one sentence to read back.

destination.description: Where they're headed, in their words, e.g. 'home' or 'the Michigan Union'.

tool_config.name: dispatch_task
tool_config.description: Start one background job: a code fix, sending an email the driver approved, or longer research. Returns instantly. Include preapproval only after a clear spoken yes to the condition.

type.description: coder, email, food or research. Leave out if unsure.

details.description: What the driver asked for, in their words (for email: the final message text).

label.description: Under 8 words, read back later, e.g. 'Fix Sarah's login bug'.

to.description: Email only: who it's for, as spoken, e.g. 'Alex'.

repo.description: Code fixes only: the repo exactly as the driver named it, e.g. 'my demo app'. Required for type coder.

preapproval.description: Only after a clear yes: the condition the driver agreed to.

condition.description: The condition in plain words, e.g. 'merge it if the tests pass'.

require_tests_pass.description: true if they said the tests must pass.

max_usd.description: A price limit in dollars, if they named one.

tool_config.name: get_status
tool_config.description: One spoken sentence about the driver's jobs on this drive. Returns instantly.

tool_config.name: approve_action
tool_config.description: Record the driver's spoken yes or no for a job waiting on approval. Only call after a clear answer. Returns instantly.

job_id.description: The pending job id from the call context.

approved.description: true only for a clear spoken yes.
